sources.title: Open Policy Agent: Policy Language
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: SCIM：離職停權、冪等同步與身分殘留
related.titleEn: SCIM: deprovisioning, idempotent sync and identity residue
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：32格都有唯一預期值且舊24格不退化；未知角色、跨租戶與唯讀寫入均拒絕。 交付24/32格矩陣、Rego或等價偽碼與逐案預期輸出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All 32 cells have unique expected outcomes with no regression in the original 24; unknown roles, cross-tenant requests and read-only writes deny. Deliver the 24/32-cell matrices, Rego or equivalent pseudocode and expected outcomes per case.
related.difference: 建立虛構HR、IdP與兩個應用程式的身分關聯表；區分停用、刪除、移除群組與撤銷既有工作階段，定義每一步成功證據。
related.differenceEn: Map fictional HR, IdP and two application identities; distinguish disabling, deletion, group removal and existing-session revocation, with evidence for each.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 完整笛卡兒積測試數=角色數×資源數×動作數；測試覆蓋不等於每格都允許，缺少測試也不能解讀為拒絕正確。 基準3角色、4資源、2動作；每組合建立一筆本機JSON輸入和預期布林結果。 3×4×2=24項；增加一個唯讀角色後4×4×2=32項，原24項需全部保留。
串行最壞停權延遲=來源偵測等待+同步排程等待+目標套用時間；這是所設教學流程的上限，不是SCIM協定保證。 來源最多5分鐘偵測、同步最多10分鐘等待、目標2分鐘套用；假設三階段串行且無重試。 最壞延遲5+10+2=17分鐘；同步等待縮為3分鐘後為10分鐘。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Complete Cartesian tests equal roles×resources×actions; coverage does not mean every case allows, and an untested cell is not a proven denial. Baseline: 3 roles, 4 resources and 2 actions, each combination represented by local JSON and an expected Boolean. 3×4×2=24 tests; adding a read-only role gives 4×4×2=32, retaining all original 24.

Serial worst-case deprovisioning delay is source detection wait plus sync wait plus target application time; it bounds this teaching workflow, not SCIM itself. Detection waits at most 5 minutes, sync waits 10 and target application takes 2; assume serial stages without retries. Worst-case delay is 5+10+2=17 minutes; reducing sync wait to 3 yields 10 minutes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RPKI 路由來源驗證：ROA 與最長前綴界線
related.titleEn: RPKI origin validation: ROAs and maximum prefix length
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：32格都有唯一預期值且舊24格不退化；未知角色、跨租戶與唯讀寫入均拒絕。 交付24/32格矩陣、Rego或等價偽碼與逐案預期輸出。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All 32 cells have unique expected outcomes with no regression in the original 24; unknown roles, cross-tenant requests and read-only writes deny. Deliver the 24/32-cell matrices, Rego or equivalent pseudocode and expected outcomes per case.
related.difference: 為保留的文件用IP範圍與虛構AS建立ROA表；逐案標示覆蓋前綴、maxLength與origin匹配，分類valid、invalid、not found。
related.differenceEn: Build a ROA table using documentation address space and fictional AS identifiers; evaluate coverage, maxLength and origin to classify valid, invalid and not found.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 完整笛卡兒積測試數=角色數×資源數×動作數；測試覆蓋不等於每格都允許，缺少測試也不能解讀為拒絕正確。 基準3角色、4資源、2動作；每組合建立一筆本機JSON輸入和預期布林結果。 3×4×2=24項；增加一個唯讀角色後4×4×2=32項，原24項需全部保留。
一個/p前綴包含2^(q−p)個/q等長子前綴；允許更長maxLength會增加可被授權的更細前綴，並非增加AS路徑保護。 只分析一個教學/20前綴，maxLength=/24，origin固定；計算最細一層可表示的子前綴數。 2^(24−20)=16個/24；maxLength改/22後最細層為2^(22−20)=4個/22。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Complete Cartesian tests equal roles×resources×actions; coverage does not mean every case allows, and an untested cell is not a proven denial. Baseline: 3 roles, 4 resources and 2 actions, each combination represented by local JSON and an expected Boolean. 3×4×2=24 tests; adding a read-only role gives 4×4×2=32, retaining all original 24.

A /p contains 2^(q−p) equal /q subprefixes; longer maxLength authorizes finer prefixes without adding AS-path protection. Analyze one teaching /20 with maxLength /24 and fixed origin; count subprefixes at the finest authorized level. 2^(24−20)=16 /24s; maxLength /22 gives 2^(22−20)=4 /22s at its finest level.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
